plan.title: Asset PR to Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute RFQ schedule.
Invite the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ.
Verify the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's RFQ quote of 100.
Verify the vendor portal accepted the quote.
Submit Vendor B's RFQ quote of 90.
Verify the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the closed RFQ into the auction round.
Commit the converted auction's schedule before publishing its new version.
Publish the converted auction.
Verify the converted auction is published.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Verify Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before awarding.
Award all available line items to Vendor A through Master QCS.
Verify the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for asset PR award to Vendor A.

steps.note: Approve the submitted award with the required remark using the configured approver context.
Complete the approval-to-PO flow.
Verify the PO contains the single awarded PR line with quantity 10.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event's History placement.
Open the History tab.
Verify the converted and awarded event appears in History.
